content: रक्षा [रक्ष्-भावे अ टाप्] .²1 Protection, preservation; guarding; मयि सृष्टिर्हि लोकानां रक्षा युष्मास्ववस्थिता <ls>Ku. 2. 28</ls>; <ls>Ś. 2. 15</ls>; <ls>R. 2. 4</ls>, <ls n="R. 2.">8</ls>; <ls>Me. 45</ls>. .²2 Care, security. .²3 A guard, watch. .²4 An amulet or mystical object used as a charm, any preservative; as in रक्षाकरण्ड <ab>q. v.</ab> below. .²4 A tutelary deity. .²5 Ashes. .²6 A piece of silk or thread fastened round the wrist on particular occasions, especially on the full-moon day of Śrāvaṇa, as an amulet or preservative; (रक्षी also in this sense). .²7 Lac.
